name: Kellac
source:
A weary man that has regrets, but still tries to smile. As a medic, he is tireless in his desire to heal others to the point of selflessness.

Uses he/him pronouns.
Likes: Healing people and being surrounded by nature.
Dislikes: Talking about himself.
